name: Arkuma
source:
The main instigator of a recent series of riots targeting the MOTH. Often sighted alongside a mysterious girl.

Without any aim of which to speak other than returning to his true form, this beast in the guise of a man will go to any length for the one human who was kind enough to give him any consolation.
